comment: Claude Code -> zcode substitutions for the pstack port. Applied in order to plugins/pstack/skills/** and docs/reference.md by tools/apply-zcode-port.mjs. Order matters: specific phrases before generic paths, generic paths before bare renames.

substitutions.pattern: /loop is a Claude Code bundled skill
substitutions.replacement: /loop maps to the **loop-me** skill on zcode

substitutions.pattern: Claude Code's per-project transcripts directory at `${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/projects/<encoded-cwd>/`
substitutions.replacement: zcode's session transcripts directory at `$HOME/.zcode/cli/rollout/` (one `model-io-sess_<session-id>.jsonl` per session)

substitutions.pattern: On Claude Code these are `TaskCreate` and `TaskUpdate`, or `TodoWrite` when configured
`run` ships with Claude Code and the model can invoke it for CLIs, TUIs, servers, and browser or Electron apps
substitutions.replacement: zcode has no bundled `run` skill, so runtime verification goes through the driver skill the Non-negotiables resolve

substitutions.pattern: such as Opus, Fable, or Sonnet

Availability depends on the model; `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` enables them through the environment or a project's `.zcode/settings.local.json` `env` block. See the [task-tool documentation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference#task-tool-availability).
substitutions.replacement: Availability depends on the zcode release; check the session's tool list.

substitutions.pattern: at least as strong as gpt-5.4-mini or a Sonnet-class Claude model. On a Haiku-class model
substitutions.replacement: at least mid-tier. On a small fast model

substitutions.pattern: names a Claude tool, a driver or bundled skill, or a Claude model
substitutions.replacement: names a zcode tool, a driver or bundled skill, or a zcode model

substitutions.pattern: tools named after the Claude ones
substitutions.replacement: tools named after the zcode ones

denylist.hint: transcript helper must be named zcode-project-dir.mjs
Claude path survived; map it to the zcode equivalent
Claude Code env var; zcode has no equivalent, rewrite the sentence
no claude CLI on zcode; MCP servers appear as mcp__<server>__<name> tools
Claude tier name; use GLM-5.3 or GLM-5.3-Flash
Claude model name in prose; use the GLM names
